item.title: Tetral Language Specification
item.description: Status This document is a work-in-progress and is subject to change and its current state does not represent a final document. Introduction Tetral, derived the Greek prefix tetra- for “four,” is a scripting language intended to be executed by an interpreter, or virtual machine, and to provide a platform-agnostic execution system. This document will serve as the specification for this language and outline key aspects of its grammar, type system and code execution.
